_readme: Copy this file to lb_settings.json and change the paths to your own. Forward slashes work on Windows too.
_rom_folders_readme: Only for systems whose games are not in the default folder. The setup wizard fills this in when you press Change next to a system.
_favourites_readme: Optional: LaunchBox platform name -> list of game titles to mark as favourites, e.g. "Arcade": ["Pac-Man"].
